# JB Staycations

> A quieter escape, just across the causeway. Private holiday houses in Johor Bahru, Malaysia, for Singapore families and groups. Host: Daniel (based in Singapore and JB; English, Malay and Chinese), WhatsApp +65 9006 2198 (https://wa.me/6590062198). Pay by PayNow or PayLah from Singapore (receipt issued), bank transfer or TNG eWallet in RM from Malaysia, or the Airbnb listing.

## Booking terms
- Prices per night for the whole house, cleaning included. Prima: RM 450 weekday, RM 650 weekend, RM 750 public holiday (about S$142 / S$205 / S$237). Landak Kawan Fun House: RM 550 weekday, RM 750 weekend, RM 1,000 public holiday (about S$174 / S$237 / S$316). SGD figures are estimates at RM1 = S$0.3158.
- No deposit for a normal gathering without food catering. A catered gathering (food catering, for example Lok Lok, or a birthday or shower gathering with catering) has a RM 1,000 deposit, refunded within 48 hours after checkout if there is no damage or stains to the house or its contents. No BBQ or grilling, and no sticking decorations on walls. Damage or stains to walls, fittings, fixtures or contents affect the refund. Bank details are shared once a booking and its dates are confirmed.
- Corporate short stays: Companies housing staff or workers for a short stay: please contact the host, Daniel, on WhatsApp to discuss a competitive rate.
- Check-in 3pm, check-out 11am; self check-in details sent after a firm booking; early check-in or late checkout RM 100 an hour, subject to availability (waiver on request).
- Minimum stay 1 night (2 nights over Christmas Eve and Christmas Day). No cancellation; dates can be changed once.
- Gatherings need the host's approval. Visitors allowed; quiet hours 11pm to 7am. No BBQ, no pets; RM 500 penalty for smoking, vaping or eating durian indoors.
- Prima has a ground-floor bedroom, so elderly guests do not need the stairs.
- Professionally cleaned after every checkout; fresh linen, towels and toiletries provided. Fire extinguisher under the kitchen sink; outdoor CCTV; the host is the emergency contact.

## Houses
- [Prima, Taman Nusantara Prima](https://jbstaycations.com/stays/prima-taman-nusantara-prima/): 19 Jalan Prima 3/1, Taman Nusantara Prima, Iskandar Puteri, Johor 79200, Malaysia. Up to 12 guests, RM 450 weekday, RM 650 weekend, RM 750 public holiday per night, cleaning included. A private landed house in Gelang Patah, Iskandar Puteri for up to 12 guests with a 7ft pool table in the living room, a mahjong table and parking for 8 cars, about 10 minutes from the Tuas Second Link (host estimate). 3 bathrooms (1 en-suite, 2 shared).
- [Landak Kawan Fun House, Taman Abad](https://jbstaycations.com/stays/landak-kawan-fun-house-taman-abad/): Jalan Landak Kawan 2, Taman Abad, Johor Bahru, Johor 80250, Malaysia. Up to 10 guests, RM 550 weekday, RM 750 weekend, RM 1,000 public holiday per night, cleaning included. A new double-storey landed fun house for up to 10 guests with an 8ft pool table, foosball, 2 dart boards, a mahjong table and a TV arcade, a 5-minute walk from KSL City Mall. 3 bathrooms (1 en-suite, 2 shared) with water heaters.
